subject: english
question:
**Direction: Replace the word in bold in the given sentence with its ANTONYM.**

Reforms were also made in the **__tedious__ **technicalities of the feudal law.
solution:
The correct answer is **"exciting."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"tedious"** means boring or monotonous. (उबाऊ और (समय की दृष्टि से) लंबा)

 
 
• **Example**: *That was a **tedious**__ journey.*
 
 
 
• The opposite of **"tedious"** is **"exciting."**
 
• **"Exciting"** means causing strong feelings of pleasure and interest. (उत्तेजक)
 __
 
• **Example**: *That was a **exciting**__ journey.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (drab)** means dull or lacking in interest. (अनाकर्षक, फीका, बेचमक, नीरस)
 
• **Option 2 (tiring)** means causing fatigue or exhaustion. (थका देने वाला; थकाऊ)
 
• **Option 4 (boring)** means uninteresting or tedious. (उबाऊ, अरुचिकर, नीरस, शुष्‍क)
